first_message:
Type mismatch: After simplification, term
  IsCompact.mul (HasCompactSupport.norm hcompact) (HasCompactSupport.norm hcompact)
 has type
  IsCompact ((tsupport fun x => ‖f x‖) * tsupport fun x => ‖f x‖)
but is expected to have type
  HasCompactSupport fun y => ‖f y‖ * ‖f y‖

Type mismatch: After simplification, term
  HasCompactSupport.mul_left (HasCompactSupport.norm hcompact)
 has type
  @HasCompactSupport ℝ ℝ PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace instMulZeroClassOfSemiring.toZero
    ((fun y => ‖f y‖) * fun x => ‖f x‖)
but is expected to have type
  @HasCompactSupport ℝ ℝ PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace Real.instZero fun y => ‖f y‖ * ‖f y‖

Type mismatch: After simplification, term
  HasCompactSupport.comp_left (HasCompactSupport.norm hcompact)
    (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_eq_true
      (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_pow (Eq.refl HPow.hPow) (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ Nat.cast_zero)
        (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℕ (Eq.refl 2)) Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.zero_natPow)
      (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ Nat.cast_zero))
 has type
  @HasCompactSupport ℝ ℝ PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace Real.instZero
    ((fun r => r ^ 2) ∘ fun x => ‖f x‖)
but is expected to have type
  @HasCompactSupport ℝ ℝ PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace Real.instZero fun y => ‖f y‖ ^ 2

Type mismatch: After simplification, term
  HasCompactSupport.mul_right (HasCompactSupport.norm hcompact)
 has type
  @HasCompactSupport ℝ ℝ PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace instMulZeroClassOfSemiring.toZero
    ((fun x => ‖f x‖) * fun y => ‖f y‖)
but is expected to have type
  @HasCompactSupport ℝ ℝ PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace Real.instZero fun y => ‖f y‖ * ‖f y‖
